{{hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Andrew Davies]].}}
'''Andrew Davis''' (also billed as '''Andy Davis''') was a guest on [[Holotheatre]] on 23 November 2022.<ref name="ht-davis">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D2keX897hEA Star Wars CCG Presents Holotheatre S3 Ep 47: Back to School with Massassi Training Temple], Star Wars CCG / Players Committee YouTube (23 November 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015182322/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D2keX897hEA Internet Archive].</ref> The episode covered the Massassi Training Temple channel.
